description.en: Archives, searches, and recalls group-chat quotes locally, with an AstrBot-style management page and an optional SnowLuma / OneBot v11 QQ channel (Node.js 22.13+; gateway settings are discovered from local SnowLuma or qq-bridge configs).
description.zh: 本地归档、检索并随机回放群聊语录，自带 AstrBot 风格管理页，可选通过 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 通道采集与回发（需 Node.js 22.13+，会从本机 SnowLuma 或 qq-bridge 配置自动发现网关地址与令牌）。
